topic: Spot the hype / how evidence works: the 1784 French royal commission (with Benjamin Franklin and Antoine Lavoisier) tested Mesmer's 'animal magnetism' by blindfolding subjects; people who believed they were magnetised but were not still fell into 'crises'; the commission found no physical force (imagination/expectation) — an early blinded, sham-controlled test that led to today's placebo-controlled, double-blind trials

cards.html:
1784.

Ben Franklin blindfolded people to test a cure.

THE CLAIM

“Animal magnetism”

Mesmer claimed an invisible healing force. A royal commission with Franklin and Lavoisier tested it.

THE TRICK

A blindfold.

People were told they were being “magnetised.” They were not.

THE RESULT

They still reacted.

Some fell into fits with no magnetism at all.

THE VERDICT

No physical force.

The effects came from imagination.

WHY IT MATTERS TODAY

Good trials still do this.

PlaceboLooks real. Nothing active.
Double-blindPatients and staff don’t know who gets what.

No placebo group? Ask why.
